description: Managed SaaS integration provider evaluated behind the VAOS Automation & Integration Fabric.

licensing.model: Managed SaaS; plan, task-usage, app-access and redistribution review required before production activation
licensing.notes: Initial AF-5 scope uses a predefined Zap with a Catch Hook trigger and a VAOS callback receipt. The Catch Hook URL is treated as a secret binding.

notes: Production qualification is blocked until duplicate-delivery behavior, callback authenticity, task-limit/held-run behavior, disabled/retired hook behavior, rate limiting, app-access policy and cost controls are evidenced.
